posts.title: Protecting all kids
posts.description: Election night brought real hope, but Washington passed I-638. What it actually asks of every girl who wants to play school sports, the lawsuit trying to stop it, and what I’m doing about it. (725 words)

posts.title: Cedar Creek Grist Mill - fall edition
posts.description: Fall colors at the Cedar Creek Grist Mill, a yearly trip back when I lived in Portland. Haven't found an equivalent near Seattle yet, but the kids are almost old enough to go looking with me. (132 words)

posts.title: Reading: Exit Party
posts.description: Emily St. John Mandel’s Exit Party splits a near-future America in two, connected by one mantra: true diligence. Now I’m halfway through The Singer’s Gun, where it all started. (281 words)
